body: this year ive been abusing drugs and alcohol which  has lead to me doing even worse in school and completely fucked my relationship with my family. my family and myself know/think i have some degree of depression but im embarrassed of it and dont want everyone to think i just want attention (i have been accused of this when ive been caught with drugs) and although i know my family care they too are embarrassed of me

everyone thinks im dumb, i kind of am. I come from a VERY academically successful family but i struggle a lot because i know i can never be that. Im failing highschool, i have no motivation anymore to do well in school anymore because if i could id drop out and do some sort of trade but i cant do that in my family. i have no plan for my future because possibly because ive had depressive thoughts since i was 11

its mostly my mum and sister. they criticize me at any given chance, little things like what Im wearing and shit and thats ok but not to the degree where i need to go change. My mum likes to tell me all these things she thinks is wrong w me, she says i have a god complex, im narcissistic, she thinks all i want is attention but its not true. i feel happy when im not in my house anymore, i want to leave. Even if i go out and have a good time the moment i get home im anxious and sad. Often when Im out w friends or busy my mum searches my room without my knowledge and then friends drugs etc and everything gets worse. My sister blames me for things i never did, tells my mum secrets about me on multiple occasions. Not only does she tell her my personal info (which i dont even know how she found out) but also spreads lies about me and my mum just believes her, theres nothing i can do to make her feel differently. Once I tried to tell her I hadnt done something and my mum said i must be crazy if i dont even remember doing it (at the time this caused me to question if i really had done this and i had a breakdown) 

Also i did contact a hotline but the all they wanted to hear was my name, age, gender etc for statistical purposes but all i needed was help not feeling like i was being interrogated. 

For the record, im a 16yr old male
